items.name: 12号鹿弹
items.desc: 一发12号鹿弹。可装填至霰弹枪中，也可在枪械枪机打开时直接装入膛室。
items.descEn: A 12 gauge buckshot round. Can be loaded into shotguns, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.

items.name: 5.56毫米子弹
items.desc: 一发步枪子弹。可装填至步枪弹匣中，也可在枪械枪机打开时直接装入膛室。
items.descEn: A rifle round. Can be loaded into a rifle magazine, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.

items.name: 9毫米子弹
items.desc: 一发手枪子弹。可装填至手枪弹匣中，也可在枪械枪机打开时直接装入膛室。
items.descEn: A small handgun round. Can be loaded into a small magazine, or directly into the chamber if the gun's bolt is open.

items.name: 创可贴
items.desc: 一包小型医用敷料，用于处理轻微伤口。可减少出血。
items.descEn: A pack of small medical dressings, made to treat small injuries. Lowers bleeding.

items.name: 自动体外除颤仪
items.desc: 一款能自动诊断并通过电击治疗心律失常的电子设备，需要放置于胸部使用。不同于手动除颤仪，它不要求使用者具备专业知识，但它工作速度更慢，耗能也更高。
items.descEn: An electronic device that diagnoses life-threatening cardiac arrhythmias and treats them via electric shocks. Use on the upper torso. Compared to a manual defibrillator, it does not require training, but takes longer to work and uses more power.

items.name: 微型AI芯片
items.desc: 一款较为简单的躯体芯片，能让内置人工智能和使用者交流并辅助完成任务。暂时派不上用场。
items.descEn: A relatively simple body chip that allows a simple AI system to communicate with the host and help them with certain tasks. You won't be able to make use of it until much later.

items.name: 酒精瓶
items.desc: 一个0.4L的玻璃瓶。
items.descEn: Glass bottle that can hold 0.4L of liquid.

items.name: 藻酸盐绷带
items.desc: 源自临床菌种、仿生物膜形成的碳水化合物类敷料。可以减缓出血、高效促进皮肤愈合并抵抗感染。
items.descEn: Dressing derived from carbohydrate sources released by clinical bacterial species, in the same manner as biofilm formation. Slows bleeding, highly improves skin healing and counteracts infections

items.name: 胺碘酮瓶
items.desc: 一个装有100mL胺碘酮的小瓶子。药物仅在注射使用时有效，所以你需要另备一支注射器取用。
items.descEn: A 100ml bottle with amiodarone. As the medication only works intravenously, you will need to get a separate syringe to fill and use.

items.name: 医用绷带
items.desc: 棉质编织纱布，含有镇痛药物。能有效减缓出血并减轻伤口疼痛。
items.descEn: Woven gauze made of cotton, containing analgesic drugs. Decent at slowing bleeding and reducing pain from injuries.

items.name: 动物肉块
items.desc: 从本地动物尸体上扯下来的肉，与你自己的肉极为相似。勉强可食，尽管有些令人反胃。
items.descEn: A ripped piece of meat from a deceased animal, native to this planet. While it is very similar to your own, it's somewhat edible, even if slightly sickening.

items.name: 抗生素药瓶
items.desc: 一瓶装有100mL抗生素的药瓶。单次口服剂量为20mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml pill bottle of antibiotic pills. Dosage is 20ml.

items.name: 抗抑郁药瓶
items.desc: 一瓶装有140mL抗抑郁药的药瓶。单次口服剂量为20mL。
items.descEn: A 140ml pill bottle of antidepressants. Dosage is 20ml.

items.name: 抗辐射剂药瓶
items.desc: 一个100mL的药瓶，瓶身印着炫酷的辐射标志。单次口服剂量为20mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml pill bottle with a cool radiation sign on it. Dosage is 20ml.

items.name: 抗菌糊剂
items.desc: 混合植物材料制成的抗菌药剂。只能使用一次。
items.descEn: Smushed together bits of fruit and foliage, resulting in a mixture effective in treating infections. Lasts one use.

items.name: 抗血清注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的自动注射器。单次注射剂量为50mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe with an autoinjector at the end. Dosage is 50ml.

items.name: 苹果汁盒
items.desc: 一个0.8L的纸盒。感觉...很天然。
items.descEn: A carton that can hold 0.8L of liquid. Feels... natural.

items.name: 水芦果
items.desc: 一种富含水分、形似气泡的果实。看起来和摸起来都有些恶心，但含水量很高。腐败速度极快。
items.descEn: A watery, bubble-shaped fruit. Looks and feels a little disgusting, but has high water content. Decays very fast.

items.name: 护臂套
items.desc: 一对蓝色保暖护臂，有一定保温作用。
items.descEn: A pair of blue arm warmers. Provides some insulation against the cold.

items.name: 自动注射器
items.desc: 这台小巧的装置问世时堪称医学奇迹，它能自动定位静脉或动脉，并精确注射指定剂量。可用于医疗方面的制作。
items.descEn: A medical marvel when it was invented, this little device is able to automatically find a vein or artery to inject to and deliver the provided dosage. Used in medicinal crafting.

items.name: 自动泵
items.desc: 穿戴时，其内置机械结构与电池会替代心脏泵血，能将你的血压维持在足以保住性命的水平。这或许能在灾难来临时为你争取更多时间。
items.descEn: While worn, pumps blood in place of your heart using a simple mechanism and an internal battery, keeping your blood pressure at livable levels. Might buy you more time to fix whatever catastrophe has befallen you.

items.name: 自动变焦护目镜
items.desc: 能提升视野范围的专业护目镜。
items.descEn: A pair of goggles that have the ability to zoom in the user's vision to see farther.

items.name: 巴拉克拉瓦头套
items.desc: 加厚保暖头套，提供基础防护和良好抗寒能力。
items.descEn: A thick, padded piece of cloth to go around your skull. Offers minor protection and decent insulation.

items.name: 香蕉
items.desc: 来自外星的美味黄色水果。具有轻微放射性。
items.descEn: A tasty yellow fruit, seemingly from another planet. Slightly radioactive.

items.name: 绷带
items.desc: 一卷带有敷料的绷带，用于减缓出血、固定骨折并促进皮肤愈合。对肌肉健康无效。
items.descEn: A roll of dressing with a bandage, used to slow down bleeding, stabilize fractures and aid skin healing. Has no effect on muscle health.

items.name: 子弹带
items.desc: 肩挂式弹药收纳带，可存放枪械子弹。
items.descEn: A pocketed belt that goes over your shoulder, made to hold ammunition. Can hold firearm rounds.

items.name: 腹部装甲
items.desc: 金属材质腹部护甲，提供优秀防护和一定保温效果。
items.descEn: A big piece of metal, made to be strapped on your abdomen. Provides great protection, and some insulation.

items.name: 皮带
items.desc: 皮质腰带，只能悬挂工具。
items.descEn: A leather belt that goes over your belly. Can only hold tools.

items.name: 双肩背包
items.desc: 标准尺寸背包。
items.descEn: A medium sized backpack.

items.name: 自行车头盔
items.desc: 一款旨在减轻头部所受冲击的头盔，比如降低因跌落造成的头部创伤。
items.descEn: A helmet designed to reduce the severity of impacts to the head. Reduces head injuries from falls.

items.name: 漂白剂瓶
items.desc: 一个1.5L的塑料瓶，里面装着漂白剂。
items.descEn: A 1.5L plastic bottle, made to hold bleach.

items.name: 眼罩
items.desc: 一块遮眼用的黑色布条。提供轻微防护，但会遮蔽视野。
items.descEn: A black piece of cloth to cover your eyes with. Offers slight protection, but closes your character's eyes.

items.name: 胶质肉块
items.desc: 诡异黏滑的肉块。饱腹又美味！但会引发轻度恶心。
items.descEn: Oddly gooey piece of flesh. Filling and tasty! Might make you minorly sick.

items.name: 血袋
items.desc: 一个带有自动注射器的0.75L塑料袋，单次自动注射375mL。在物品栏使用会从你身上抽取血液。
items.descEn: A 0.75L plastic bag with an autoinjector at the end. Injects 375mL on use. Use in the inventory to draw blood from yourself.

items.name: 红血袋
items.desc: 一个带有自动注射器的0.75L塑料袋，单次自动注射375mL。在物品栏使用会从你身上抽取血液。袋子上残留着些许红色痕迹。
items.descEn: A 0.75L plastic bag with an autoinjector at the end. Injects 375mL on use. Use in the inventory to draw blood from yourself. There's traces of red on it.

items.name: 促凝剂注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的自动注射器。单次注射剂量为34mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe with an auto-injector at the end. Dosage is ~34mL.

items.name: 生血晶碎片
items.desc: 会用渗出的血液浸染任何接触到的东西。贴身携带时可缓慢恢复血容量至正常水平。
items.descEn: Seeps blood into anything it touches. Slowly increases your blood volume up to normal levels while stored on your body.

items.name: 血囊
items.desc: 内含血液的小型肉质囊袋，里面的血液看起来和你的血液区别不大。可食用或用于制作。
items.descEn: A small, fleshy sac with blood in it. Doesn't look too different from your blood. Can be eaten or used in crafting.

items.name: 蓝图
items.desc: 记录某种配方的图纸，还附有某种芯片...使用后可以学习该配方并增加你的智力经验。
items.descEn: Has the recipe for some kind of object written on it. There is some kind of electronic chip attached to it... Use to learn the recipe and gain INT experience.

items.name: 骨骼焊接器
items.desc: 一种处于早期试验阶段的装置，能够将骨折部位重新焊合，大幅加快愈合速度。该过程会对肢体造成损伤——建议配合绷带使用。
items.descEn: A very experimental bit of technology that welds a fracture back together, vastly speeding up healing. Causes some damage to the limb due to the process - better have some dressing ready.

items.name: 谷物碗
items.desc: 一个容量0.5L的叶片碗。不知为何，你居然只有在泡麦片的时候才能弄出这玩意儿。
items.descEn: A foliage bowl that can hold 0.5L of liquid. Somehow, you're unable to create it without the cereal.

items.name: 纸箱
items.desc: 中型纸板箱。
items.descEn: A medium-sized cardboard box.

items.name: 12号霰弹盒
items.desc: 可存放16发12号霰弹的弹盒。在物品栏使用可以取出一发子弹。
items.descEn: A box that can store sixteen 12-Gauge rounds. Use to unload a shell to insert into a firearm.

items.name: 增脑剂瓶
items.desc: 一个容量为100mL的药瓶。单次口服剂量为20mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml pill bottle. Dosage is 20ml.

items.name: 面包
items.desc: 一块由面粉和水制成的面包。几乎是你能吃到的最简陋的口粮了，不算难吃，而且能保存很长时间。
items.descEn: A loaf of bread, made of flour and water. About the simplest thing you could eat, though not repulsive and will last for a long time.

items.name: 破损的书包
items.desc: 严重磨损的旧书包，背带已经断裂，无法背负。
items.descEn: An old, heavily worn school bag. The straps are torn and unusable, rendering the bag unwearable.

items.name: 棕菌盖
items.desc: 一朵你分辨不出品种的菌菇。对于它是能治愈伤病，还是能当场夺命，你心里完全没底。
items.descEn: You aren't sure what kind of fungus it is exactly. For all you know, it could do anything from curing wounds to killing you on the spot.

items.name: 瘀伤治疗包
items.desc: 促进肌肉愈合的复方医疗包。可以恢复肌肉、皮肤健康度，并高效治疗脱臼。无法止血。
items.descEn: A combination of drugs and other medicines, made to aid muscle healing. Increases muscle/skin health and highly aids dislocations. Doesn't affect bleeding.

items.name: 桶装炸鸡
items.desc: 满满一桶鸡腿，非常管饱，保质期极长。
items.descEn: A bunch of chicken legs in a bucket. Very filling. Has an exceedingly long shelf life.

items.name: 空炸鸡桶
items.desc: 空空如也的炸鸡桶。
items.descEn: An empty chicken bucket.

items.name: 炮果皮
items.desc: 一块厚实的黄色膜状组织。能够缓解口渴，但可能轻微影响脑功能。也可作为临时绷带和镇痛剂使用。
items.descEn: A piece of thick, yellow membrane. Satiates thirst, but might minorly affect brain function. Can also be used as a makeshift bandage and analgesic.

items.name: 凝血菇块
items.desc: 具有凝血特性的菌类组织。单独使用效果不佳，需进一步提炼使用...
items.descEn: A piece of fungus with clot-promoting properties. While not particularly useful on its own, it could be refined further...

items.name: 一捆导线
items.desc: 一捆由绝缘材料包裹、整齐捆扎的导线，用于电子产品方面的制作。
items.descEn: Bundle of neatly tied together wires with some isolation around them. Used in electronics crafting.

items.name: 汉堡
items.desc: 美味的大型零食。同时满足胃袋与心灵！
items.descEn: A big, tasty snack. Fills both your tummy and soul!

items.name: 仙人掌肉
items.desc: 甘甜多汁，可惜长满尖刺。美味又解渴，但吃的时候会痛。
items.descEn: Sweet, high in water content and prickly. Tasty and hydrating, but it hurts to eat.

items.name: 蛋糕
items.desc: 一种烘烤甜点，表面覆有糖霜。分量足、管饱、还风味极佳。不过糖分太高，吃多了会有点腻。
items.descEn: A baked, sweet pastry with some glaze layered ontop. Large, filling and very tasty, though the sugar content makes it a little sickening if eaten too much.

items.name: 营火
items.desc: 散发阵阵暖意的营火。靠近即可恢复体温。可以在多种食物配方中作为热源使用。
items.descEn: A lit campfire. Warm and cozy, you'll heat up when next to it. Used as a heat source in a variety of food recipes.

items.name: 糖果棒
items.desc: 美味的糖果棒。不易腐败但饱腹感差，过量食用可能引发肠胃不适。
items.descEn: A nice, tasty candy bar. Lasts long, but not very filling. Might make you sick if overeaten.

items.name: 水壶
items.desc: 普通的小型液体容器，由几块塑料块粘合拼接，再用绳子捆扎固定而成。容量300mL。
items.descEn: Simple, small bottle for holding liquids, made with some glued together chunks of plastic tied together with rope. Holds 300mL.

items.name: 帆布
items.desc: 由植物纤维制成的轻薄柔韧的布。以这种材质来说，耐用性还算不错。
items.descEn: Thin, flexible sheet made of plant matter. Light and decently durable for what it is.

items.name: 微单体电容器
items.desc: 一款先进的微型电池。能在短时间充放巨量能量。暂时派不上用场。
items.descEn: An advanced nano-battery that can store and discharge a monstrous amount of energy in a short timespan. You won't be able to make use of it until much later.

items.name: 壳状护甲
items.desc: 一件保护胸部的钢制壳状护甲，尽显威严。
items.descEn: A sturdy steel carapace to protect your thorax. Feels royal.

items.name: 硬化虫尸
items.desc: 大型昆虫被碾碎后的坚硬残骸。可用于制作。
items.descEn: The hard, crushed remains of a sizeable insect. Used in crafting.

items.name: 虫尸夹板
items.desc: 多具虫尸拼接的长管，可作为骨折治疗的简易夹板。
items.descEn: A hard, long tube made from multiple joined carcasses. Functions as a decent makeshift splint for treating fractures.

items.name: 弹壳
items.desc: 一枚空弹壳。本身没什么用，但可用于制作。
items.descEn: Empty casing. While it's not of much use by itself, you could use it in crafting.

items.name: 头孢曲松注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的注射器，用于注射液体。可从注射器自带的小型储液瓶取药。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. This one has a small bottle next to it to draw from.

items.name: 谷物片
items.desc: 普通盒装谷物。干吃乏味但能饱腹，略微加剧口渴。
items.descEn: A box of generic cereal. Not exactly fun to eat dry, but it's filling and not repulsive. Slightly increases thirst.

items.name: 炭条
items.desc: 一小块轻质炭条。可在制作中作为易燃材料使用。
items.descEn: Small, light piece of charcoal. Can be used as a flammable ingredient for crafting.

items.name: 胸腔引流器
items.desc: 用于排出胸腔积液，缓解血胸症状。可重复使用，只能用于胸部。
items.descEn: Used to drain fluid from the thorax. Reduces hemothoraces, reusable after some time. Only usable on the chest.

items.name: 薯片
items.desc: 袋装薄脆烤土豆片。美味但不健康。
items.descEn: A pack of thin, baked slices of potato. Tasty, but not the healthiest.

items.name: 巧克力棒
items.desc: 没有包装的巧克力棒。美味但你不太能消化。
items.descEn: A bar of unpackaged chocolate. Tasty, but you can't digest it well.

items.name: 巧克力奶瓶
items.desc: 一个1L的大塑料瓶。
items.descEn: A large plastic bottle that holds up to a liter of liquid.

items.name: 电路板
items.desc: 从报废机器上扯下来的一小块电路板，偶尔还会闪烁火花。可用于制作。
items.descEn: A bit of circuitry, ripped out of a once working machine. It still sparks occasionally. Used in crafting.

items.name: 爪套
items.desc:
它虽然看起来像个玩具，但却异常锋利坚固。拿着它时你觉得自己威风凛凛。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
Even though it looks like a toy, it's scarily tough and sharp. You feel like you'd look cool holding it.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 攀爬爪
items.desc: 钢制爪套，为有效抓附墙壁而特制，能让你在单侧墙体无限次蹬墙跳。
items.descEn: A pair of steel claws that go over your hands, specifically designed to attach to walls effectively. Grants you the ability to walljump on the same wall indefinitely.

items.name: 攀爬绳
items.desc: 一长条加固过的绳索，两端都有固定点。将其架在悬崖边，就能顺着它爬下去。可以使用两次。
items.descEn: A long, strengthened sheet of rope with attachment points at each end. You could place it over a large drop and use it to climb down. Has two uses.

items.name: 凝血糊剂
items.desc: 促进凝血的小瓶药膏，需要放在特殊容器中以防止变质。虽然单独使用时效果不佳，但它可以进一步提炼...
items.descEn: A small vial of a clot-promoting poultice. Needs to be held in a special container in order to not go bad. While not particularly useful on its own, it could be refined further...

items.name: 咖啡杯
items.desc: 一个0.25L的纸杯。
items.descEn: A paper cup that can hold 0.25L of liquid.

items.name: 战斗注射笔
items.desc: 一支100mL的注射笔，能将内容物瞬间全部注入体内。内含混合制剂，旨在快速稳定伤员状态，并在战斗场景中提供支援。
items.descEn: A 100ml injector pen which instantly injects its contents into the body. Contains a mixture intended to quickly stabilize casualties and aid in combat scenarios.

items.name: 饼干盒
items.desc: 盒装小块烘焙甜点。美味，但不是最健康的选择。
items.descEn: A pack of small, baked sweet snacks. Tasty, but not the healthiest.

items.name: 临时瓶子
items.desc: 临时液体容器。无法被重新填充，而且很快就会消失。请在消失前将内容物转移至其他容器。
items.descEn: Improvised water container. Cannot be refilled and will soon disappear. Transfer the contents somewhere before it's gone.

items.name: 粗制菜刀
items.desc:
一把简单拼接成的金属菜刀，刀刃直接钉在了刀柄上。制作时效果不错。拿着它让你感到不安。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
Cobbled together metal cleaver, with a blade nailed onto the handle. Would do well in crafting. You feel uneasy holding it.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 冷冻核心
items.desc: 一款可调控周边温度的先进装置。将其投入岩浆，或是佩戴者体温升至阈值时，装置便会自行激活。其激活后可凝固周遭全部岩浆，并大幅降低你的体温。仅能单次使用。
items.descEn: An advanced device capable of controlling temperature around it. If thrown into molten rock, or if your body temperature rises high enough, it will activate, solidifying all magma around you and cooling you down considerably. One-time use.

items.name: 消化晶碎片
items.desc: 它似乎在疏通你体内的浊气...贴身携带时减轻反胃程度。
items.descEn: It feels as if it's taking matter out of your body... Decreases sickness while stored on your body.

items.name: 消毒剂瓶
items.desc: 一个带喷嘴的0.2L塑料瓶。每次喷出10mL液体。
items.descEn: A 0.2L plastic bottle with a spray nozzle on it. Can spray 10ml of liquid at a time.

items.name: 狗粮
items.desc: 对你这类犬科生物颇具吸引力的食物。
items.descEn: Seems inviting, considering you're canine.

items.name: 钻探舱维修工具包
items.desc: 一小包用于维修钻探舱的备用零件，需要一套才能让钻探舱恢复运转。
items.descEn: A small bundle of spare parts, made to repair Drill Pods. You could use one of these to get a pod back into a working state.

items.name: 屎
items.desc: 这是坨屎。
items.descEn: It's poop.

items.name: 干燥植物纤维
items.desc: 干燥后看起来更像是能吃的东西了，可能引发肠胃不适。
items.descEn: Seems slightly more appealing to consume when it's dry. Might make you a little sick.

items.name: 帆布背包
items.desc: 容量可观的织物背包。
items.descEn: A decently sized bag made of fabric.

items.name: 防尘面罩
items.desc: 覆盖口鼻的简易防护罩，提供基础头部防护。
items.descEn: A slightly sturdy mask that covers your mouth. Offers minor head protection.

items.name: 炸药棒
items.desc: 由硝化甘油、吸附剂、稳定剂制成的爆炸物。在破坏地形方面表现不错，不过对耳朵不太友好。
items.descEn: An explosive made of nitroglycerin, sorbents, and stabilizers. Good for making holes in the terrain. Not very good for your ears.

items.name: 耳罩
items.desc: 金属头带连接的现代双耳护垫。能抵御噪音，不知为何...也能勉强保温。不过对极端噪音也无能为力。
items.descEn: A modern pair of cushions connected by a metal head-band. Protects you from loud noises and provides some insulation...somehow. Won't do much against extremely loud sounds.

items.name: 应急手电筒
items.desc: 一款微型、一次性应急手电筒。在电量耗尽前，你可能需要寻找新的光源。左键点击以开关。
items.descEn: A tiny, one-time use emergency flashlight. You'll probably want to find a new source of light before it runs out. Use to toggle.

items.name: 夜明晶碎片
items.desc: 能持续发出强光，但时长有限。失效前都是个不错的光源。
items.descEn: Glows brightly, for a time. Useful as a light source while it lasts.

items.name: 能量饮料罐
items.desc: 一个0.25L的汽水罐，上面有着醒目的标识。
items.descEn: A 0.25L soda can with bright markings on it.

items.name: 电子个人数字助理
items.desc: 电子个人数字助理，很可能被看守们不小心遗留在维生舱里。只要装上电池，你就能查阅他们的笔记，并获取一些知识。
items.descEn: Electronic personal digital assistant, likely accidentally left in a lifepod by your captors. If you get a battery into it, you could probably read up on their notes and gain some new knowledge.

items.name: 黄色肉块
items.desc: 从同类身上撕下的肉块。能充饥但令人作呕。
items.descEn: A ripped piece of flesh from one of your own. Filling, but sickening.

items.name: 暴露的核心
items.desc: 某种曾经具有生命之物留下的休眠残骸。你可以吃下它，以营养和水分的形式吸收其中能量。<color="red">若不及时食用，它会变化成某种东西...
items.descEn: The dormant remains of something once animated. You could eat it to absorb its energy in the form of nutrients and water. <color="red">If not eaten, will eventually morph into something...

items.name: 腰包
items.desc: 佩戴在腹部的小型收纳包。
items.descEn: A small bag made to be put on your belly.

items.name: 芬太尼注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的注射器，需要注射使用。这一支装有镇痛用的稀释芬太尼溶液。标签写着稀释溶液过量剂量为20mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. This one comes with diluted fentanyl for pain relief. The overdose label reads 20ml.

items.name: 过滤吸管
items.desc: 主手持有时，可安全饮用地下水，并降低其他液体对健康带来的负面影响。饮用容器里的水时同样生效。
items.descEn: Can be used to safely drink groundwater and reduce the health impact of other liquids when held in the main hand. Also works when drinking from bottles.

items.name: 引火器
items.desc: 一种生火装置，原理是让木杆快速旋转，与固定木块的凹槽摩擦生热，简单来说就是钻木取火。在烧坏前可以使用3次。
items.descEn: A device to start a fire by friction between a rapidly rotating wooden rod and a cavity on a stationary wood piece. In layman's terms, stick rotatey, fire starty. Can be used up to 3 times before burning out.

items.name: 易燃粉末
items.desc: 高度易燃的细腻粉末，可用于制作爆炸物。
items.descEn: A chalky and highly flammable powder. Useful in making explosives.

items.name: 手电筒
items.desc: 能大范围照亮前方区域，同时也会缓慢耗电。左键点击以切换模式。
items.descEn: Lights up a large area in front of it, but slowly loses battery. Use to change mode.

items.name: 巨大肉块
items.desc: 巨型高脂肪肉块，肯定是来自于某种大型生物。极其饱腹且增重。
items.descEn: A giant, very fatty chunk of flesh. Must've come from something big. Very filling and fattening.

items.name: 柔性玻璃
items.desc: 一张由化学处理塑料制成的薄片，柔韧透明。可用于合成。
items.descEn: A thin sheet of flexible, transparent material, made from chemically treated plastic. Used in crafting.

items.name: 脆弱小刀
items.desc:
一把脆弱粗钝的小刀。用于基础制作，在战斗中几乎无用。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
A small, dull, brittle knife. Can be used for rudimentary crafting. Little to no use in combat.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 植物纤维
items.desc: 普通外星植物。勉强可以食用，但味道很糟糕，还会导致恶心。腐坏迅速，常用于制作物品。
items.descEn: Generic alien plant life. Barely edible, with a dissatisfying taste. Might make you sick. Decays fast. Often used in crafting.

items.name: 植物纤维袋
items.desc: 用植物纤维捆扎而成的脆弱袋子。
items.descEn: A very flimsy bag made of tied together foliage.

items.name: 叶片餐
items.desc: 一份还不错的食物，由爽脆的植物纤维和简单的馅料制成。保质期不长且不含脂肪，但非常饱腹。
items.descEn: A decent prepared food, made of crispy foliage and rudimentary filling. Won't last for long and has no fat, but it's very filling.

items.name: 寒霜果
items.desc: 冰冷坚硬的透明果实。美味但会大幅降低你的体温，在严寒环境下慎食。
items.descEn: A very cold, hard and glassy fruit. Tasty, but has a tendency to cool you down a lot. Consider not consuming it out in the freezing cold.

items.name: 菌类块
items.desc: 一块撕下的菌类组织。能不能算食物可不好说，会不会有副作用更不好说。
items.descEn: A ripped piece of fungi. Does a decent enough job as food, though you're unsure about the side effects.

items.name: 盖革计数器
items.desc: 一种使用盖革-米勒管来监测电离辐射的电子仪器。在物品栏使用来开关。
items.descEn: An electronic instrument for detecting and measuring ionizing radiation with the use of a Geiger–Müller tube. Use to toggle.

items.name: 地菱果
items.desc: 朴实但美味的水果，生长于地菱树上。热量低，能略微解渴，但极易腐坏。
items.descEn: Basic, but tasty fruit. Grows on geo-trees. Low in calories, reduces some thirst and decays fast.

items.name: 发光果
items.desc: 不可食用的生物荧光体，所含温和毒素可抗感染。其汁液能促进化学反应，可用于制作。
items.descEn: Bioluminescent and inedible. Has moderately dangerous toxins inside; counteracts infections. Its juice promotes chemical reactions, making it useful in crafting.

items.name: 抓钩枪
items.desc: 一种发射绳索抓钩的金属装置。说明书已遗失。
items.descEn: A metal device that launches a hook attached with a rope. The instruction manual is missing.

items.name: 重力袋
items.desc: 一种处于早期实验阶段的容器，通过产生负重力来抵消内部物品的重量。当电池电量接近耗尽时，有发生爆炸的风险。
items.descEn: A very experimental container that generates negative gravity in order to reduce the weight of whatever's in it. Has explosive tendencies when its battery nears empty.

items.name: 手摇式充电器
items.desc: 一种通过手摇曲柄为耗尽的电池重新充电的设备。放入电池，然后开转吧！
items.descEn: A device which can recharge spent batteries via a manual cranking motion. Slot in a battery and crank away!

items.name: 硬糖
items.desc: 一小袋硬质糖果。美味但不顶饿。
items.descEn: A pack of small, hard candy. Tasty, but not filling.

items.name: 头灯
items.desc: 能绑在额头上的小手电，会持续消耗电量。
items.descEn: A little flashlight, made to be strapped onto your forehead. Loses battery over time.

items.name: 热蕨孢囊
items.desc: 从热蕨上撕下来的干瘪孢囊。可敷于肢体以对抗感染，也可食用补充营养。其中残留的孢子可能会影响你的免疫系统。
items.descEn: The ripped off, shriveled up spore container of a heatfern. Can be used on a limb to counteract infection or eaten for nutritional value. Its spores might impact your immune system.

items.name: 重型钻机
items.desc: 笨重的手持机械钻，效率极高但挖掘距离有限。
items.descEn: A big, heavy, mechanical handheld drill. Very efficient, though lacks range.

items.name: 紫辛药
items.desc: 一种干燥的紫色草药，味道极辣。有助于减轻反胃程度，轻微改善听力损伤，并能减轻内出血。服用后会导致体温大幅升高。
items.descEn: A dry, purple herb with an especially spicy taste. Helps against sickness, slightly helps hearing loss and might lessen internal bleeding. Highly increases the consumer's body temperature.

items.name: 海洛因注射器
items.desc: 一支150mL的注射器，用于注射液体。这一支的刻度有些模糊，也缺少了指导剂量的标签。
items.descEn: A 150ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. This one is missing the graduation marks and dosage guides.

items.name: 节日帽
items.desc: 你听说人们会在某个特别的日子里戴上这种帽子，只是不太清楚是为了庆祝什么。不过，至少他们送你过来时还给你配了一顶，倒也不错。
items.descEn: You've heard that people wear these for some kind of special occasion, though you're not sure what it's about. It's nice that you were sent with one, at least.

items.name: 连帽衫
items.desc: 超大号黑色帽衫，保暖且配有小口袋。
items.descEn: A black, very oversized hoodie that keeps you warm and has a small pocket.

items.name: 冰敷包
items.desc: 一只自冷却凝胶冰袋。在医疗面板中对肢体使用，可以加速肌肉健康恢复、减轻疼痛并略微降温。随时间自动回复耐久。
items.descEn: A cold bag filled with self-cooling refrigerant gel. Speeds up muscle healing, reduces pain and cools you down slightly. Automatically cools itself over time.

items.name: 冰茶瓶
items.desc: 一个0.5L的瓶子。这个瓶子还透出橙色色泽。
items.descEn: A 0.5L bottle. This one has an orange tint to it.

items.name: 钛铁矿块
items.desc: 一块钛铁氧化物矿石。虽然开采和加工成本较高，但可加工成坚固的钛合金。
items.descEn: A titanium-iron oxide mineral. Though costly, it can be processed into a strong titanium alloy.

items.name: 内脏团
items.desc: 一团被压实的内脏，一只橙色眼球从里面凸出来。看体型，应该来自和你差不多的生物。能充饥，但令人极度恶心反胃。
items.descEn: A solid compressed ball of displaced internal organs, you can see an orange eyeball sticking out. Looks like they came from a creature sized closely to you. Filling, but horribly disgusting and sickening.

items.name: 喷气背包
items.desc: 一款背部喷射推进装置，可以利用喷流推动使用者在空中移动。燃料有限，装置在潮湿时还会失效。按住 [Up] 来使用，该设备也带有小口袋来存放物品。
items.descEn: A device worn as a backpack which uses jets to propel the wearer through the air. Has limited fuel and will be impaired while wet. Hold [Up] to use. It also has a little pocket to store things inside.

items.name: 角蛋白增强剂瓶
items.desc: 一个100mL的药瓶，标签上写着指甲护理补充剂。单次口服剂量为50mL。
items.descEn: A 100mL bottle labelled as a nail care supplement. Dosage is 50mL per drink.

items.name: 番茄酱瓶
items.desc: 一个0.3L的调味瓶。
items.descEn: A 0.3L table condiment bottle.

items.name: 动量耦合芯片
items.desc: 一款实验性芯片，能在两点附近创造微型时空扭曲，在任意方向上超距地推动使用者和物体。暂时派不上用场。
items.descEn: An experimental chip that creates a miniature spacetime distortion localized around two points, telekinetically pushing the host and the object in any chosen direction. You won't be able to make use of it until much later.

items.name: 护膝
items.desc: 塑料护膝垫，可为小腿提供充足防护，并缓冲撞击伤害。
items.descEn: Plastic pads, made to protect the knees and cushion impacts.

items.name: 提灯
items.desc: 内置明亮黄水晶的简易木框玻璃提灯。
items.descEn: A simple, wood and glass lantern with a bright yellow crystal inside of it.

items.name: 大型电池
items.desc: 工业级大容量电池，只适用于特定电子设备。容量为中型的三倍。
items.descEn: A large industrial battery that can be inserted into certain electronic devices. Stores three times as much as a medium battery.

items.name: 大型虫尸
items.desc: 两具虫尸拼接成的半管状结构。可用于制作。
items.descEn: Two insect carcasses joined together, forming a half-tube shape. Used in crafting.

items.name: 乳胶手套
items.desc: 一双朴素的乳胶手套。提供轻微保温效果。
items.descEn: A pair of simple latex gloves. Offers minor insulation from the elements.

items.name: 液晶显示屏
items.desc: 一个简单电子显示屏，可用于制作。
items.descEn: A simple electronic display, used in crafting.

items.name: 腿包
items.desc: 可绑在大腿上的皮质小包，完美符合你对口袋的想象！
items.descEn: A leather pouch with straps made to go around the thigh. It's like a pocket pocket!

items.name: 柠檬水罐
items.desc: 一个0.75L的罐子。出乎意料地结实。
items.descEn: A jar that can hold 0.75L of liquid. Surprisingly tough.

items.name: 灯泡
items.desc: 电池供电的白炽灯泡。请勿入口。
items.descEn: An electric light with a filament that is heated until it glows. Seems to be battery powered. Don't put it in your mouth.

items.name: 打火机
items.desc: 一款普通的翻盖式打火机。可在多种制作配方中作为火源使用，例如燃起营火。它极其耐用。
items.descEn: A generic flip top lighter. Can be used as a flame source for many crafting recipes, such as lighting campfires. Lasts many, many uses.

items.name: 缠布
items.desc: 纱布制成的简易护具，为四肢提供少量防护，还能让你平添几分战士气质。
items.descEn: Makeshift wraps made from gauze to cover the extremities. Slightly protects your arms and feet from damage and makes you feel like a warrior.

items.name: 液体离心机
items.desc: 一种手持式离心机，能够低效地将混合物分离为其基本成分。该过程相当复杂，导致每种液体约三分之一的液体量流失。每60秒完成一次充能。
items.descEn: A handheld centrifuge that can inefficiently split a mixture into its base components. The process is rather complex and results in about a third of the total liquid volume being lost. Recharges every 60 seconds.

items.name: 随身水包
items.desc: 一个用于储存液体的柔性袋子，配有可固定在腰部的绑带。你可以把瓶子里的液体倒进去，也可以反过来把里面的液体倒进瓶子。
items.descEn: A flexible liquid pouch made to store liquids. Has a strap to go over your belly. You can fill it with bottles and vice-versa.

items.name: 开锁工具包
items.desc: 一套小型工具，用于高效开启各类锁具。带在身上即可在撬锁时自动使用，使用需10级智力，其效果随智力提升而增强。
items.descEn: A small array of tools used to efficiently get all sorts of locks open. Have it anywhere in your inventory when picking a lock to use. Needs 10 INT to use, effectiveness scales with higher INT.

items.name: 局部复苏装置
items.desc: 一台局部复苏装置，可便捷提供全面创伤护理。可恢复使用部位的肌肉健康、减缓出血、镇痛并消毒，对相邻的肢体有同样效果。若用于胸部，可大幅减缓内出血。至少需要25mL LRD血清才能正常运作。
items.descEn: A Localized Resuscitation Device, made to easily provide effective general trauma care. Increases limb health, slows bleeding, provides pain relieving drugs and disinfects the limb it's used on, along with any adjacent limbs. Highly reduces internal bleeding if used on the chest. Requires at least 25mL of LRD serum to function.

items.name: 砍刀
items.desc:
一把宽刃金属大刀，很适合近身搏斗。拿着它让你感到不安。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
A big, broad metal blade. Would do well in melee combat. You feel uneasy holding it.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 弹匣基底
items.desc: 带弹簧的特制容器，用于制作弹匣与枪械。
items.descEn: A specially shaped container with a spring in it. Used in magazine and firearm making.

items.name: 简易挖掘工具
items.desc: 捆扎金属制成的简易物块挖掘工具，结构脆弱。
items.descEn: A piece of thrown together and tied up metal, made for digging through rock. It's a bit flimsy.

items.name: 简易头灯
items.desc: 直接用发光果实绑在额头的照明装置。虽不舒适，但能腾出物品栏空间。
items.descEn: It's just a glowplant fruit strapped to your forehead. Not exactly comfortable, but frees up some inventory space.

items.name: 简易头盔
items.desc: 用绳子和动物残骸粗制而成的头盔，提供基础头部防护。
items.descEn: A rudimentary helmet made out of some rope and stitched together carcasses. Provides some head protection.

items.name: 简易局部复苏装置
items.desc: 一台简易局部复苏装置，似乎是用胶带拼凑起的。可恢复使用部位的肌肉健康度并为其消毒，对相邻的肢体有同样效果。若用于胸部，可略微减缓内出血。至少需要25mL LRD血清才能正常运作。
items.descEn: A makeshift Localized Resuscitation Device. Looks like it's taped together. Increases the muscle health and disinfects limb it's used on, AND any directly adjacent limbs. Slightly reduces internal bleeding if used on the chest. Requires at least 25mL of LRD serum to function.

items.name: 简易步枪
items.desc: 用废管材拼凑的栓动步枪，使用9毫米手枪弹匣。潮湿或低耐久时可能卡壳。主手持握以操作。
items.descEn: An improvised bolt-action firearm, made of scrapped together tubes and gun scraps. Uses small magazines loaded with 9mm rounds. Might jam when wet or low condition. Hold in your main hand to use and see controls.

items.name: 简易扳手
items.desc: 比起拧螺栓，这把粗糙的扳手恐怕更擅长把它砸进去。无法治疗脱臼，但在制作中比较实用。
items.descEn: A crude tool that's probably better at hitting bolts into place than actually turning them. It won't help with dislocations, but is useful in crafting.

items.name: 手动除颤仪
items.desc: 一款用于治疗心律失常的电子设备，需要放置于胸部使用。该设备为手动款，需要一定专业知识才能正确操作。与自动体外除颤仪相比，它的工作速度更快，耗能更低，但依赖操作者的水平。更高的智力会使操作更简单。
items.descEn: An electronic device used to stabilize dangerous heart rhythms. Use on the upper torso. This one is manual, and will require some know-how to use correctly. Compared to an AED, it's faster and uses less power, but isn't guaranteed to work. Higher INT makes operation easier.

items.name: 材料包
items.desc: 一个坚固的大型腿包，带有许多用来存放制作材料的小口袋。能够大幅度减轻负重，但只能容纳材料类物品。
items.descEn: A large, sturdy pouch that attaches to your thigh, with many small pockets to hold crafting materials. Has a high encumbrance reduction, but only accepts materials.

items.name: 医用缝合线
items.desc: 用于缝合伤口。可立即止住大部分出血并恢复皮肤健康度。
items.descEn: Used to stitch wounds back together. Instantly stops most bleeding and increases skin health.

items.name: 中型电池
items.desc: 标准通用电池，容量为小型的两倍、大型的三分之一。
items.descEn: A generic battery that can be inserted into various electronic devices. Stores twice as much as a small battery, but a third as much as a large one.

items.name: 医疗箱
items.desc: 一个小巧的盒子，能紧凑地收纳各类药品。
items.descEn: A small box which can efficiently hold various medicines.

items.name: 雇佣兵围巾
items.desc: 借由其中嵌入的芯片，这围巾能赋予佩戴者提供巨大的力量。它需要某种特殊的能量源，充能时间也很长...你一定要带着它，活着走出这洞穴。
items.descEn: Provides immense power to the user via its implanted chips. It needs some kind of special power source, and a long while to charge... You need to make it out of this cave, with it, alive.

items.name: 牛奶盒
items.desc: 一个1L的牛奶盒。
items.descEn: A carton that can hold a liter of liquid.

items.name: 精神抹除剂瓶
items.desc: 一个60mL的药瓶。鉴于精神抹除是一个十分痛苦的过程，对半加入了吗啡用来缓解痛苦。
items.descEn: A 60ml pill bottle. Because mindwiping is a painful process, it comes with an equal mix of morphine to ease the transition slightly.

items.name: 迷你桶
items.desc: 一种存储液体的小型工业用桶，极其笨重且不方便使用。
items.descEn: A small, industrial barrel made for storing liquids. Extremely heavy and impractical to use.

items.name: 迷你血肉重建仪
items.desc: 一种使用肉块样本来治疗严重创伤的实验性设备。如果装入三块黄色肉块，就能重建一个缺失的头部器官，还是个不错的光源！
items.descEn: An experimental medical device that uses samples of flesh in order to heal traumatic injuries. If filled with three pieces of yellow flesh, can rebuild missing facial features. Also a mediocre light source!

items.name: 微型激光钻
items.desc: 民用级小型激光挖掘工具，效率一般但无需消耗体力。
items.descEn: A small, consumer-grade laser drill. Not the best at digging, but uses no stamina.

items.name: 吗啡注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的注射器，用于注射液体。标签写着过量剂量为88mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. The overdose label reads 88ml.

items.name: MP3播放器
items.desc: 没想到它还能正常工作。它配有小型存储器，存有几首音乐。你可以随意播放一首来解解闷。
items.descEn: Surprisingly, it still seems to work. It has a small storage drive, with a few music tracks saved on it. You could play either of them for your own amusement.

items.name: 水芦藤
items.desc: 不可食用的植物部位，可作为一次性简易绷带使用，能在制作时作为纤维使用。
items.descEn: Inedible plant part, useful as a one-time makeshift bandage. Can be used as foliage for crafting.

items.name: 水芦莓
items.desc: 水芦的一部分，负责过滤并输送水分。味道令人不适，但具有奇特的减重特性，食用后会降低体重。似乎含有微量阿片类物质。
items.descEn: A part of a hydreed that filters and distributes water. Has an odd weight-absorbing property and an off-putting taste. Lowers body mass when eaten. Seems to have trace opioid concentration.

items.name: 安眠尾
items.desc: 水芦的尾端部分。含有某种奇怪的化学物质，能使人立即昏睡一段时间，并在醒来后明显改善情绪。没有营养价值。
items.descEn: The tail-end of a hydreed. Contains a chemical which can instantly knock someone out for a while, with a visible mood increase afterwards. Odd. No nutritional value.

items.name: 铁钉
items.desc: 一堆做工粗糙的钉子。数量应该够做几个东西了。你需要一把锤子来捶打它们。
items.descEn: A pile of crudely made nails. Should be enough to last a few recipes. You'll probably need a hammer to drive them.

items.name: 纳洛酮注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的注射器，用于注射液体。你只能从品牌名上辨认出字母“N”。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. You can't make out the brand's name other than the "N".

items.name: 纳曲酮药瓶
items.desc: 一个100mL的药瓶。单次口服剂量是20mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml pill bottle. Dosage is 20ml.

items.name: 纳米科技扫描仪
items.desc: 一款能探查各种躯体芯片的设备，扫描其痕迹信号，提示其大致位置。在物品栏中使用即可阅读关于芯片的信息。<color="red">仅放在主六格物品栏中才会生效。</color>
items.descEn: A device that detects the specific tech-signatures of various body chips, showing their general location. There's some info about the chips written on the side, use to read it. <color="red">Only works when in the main inventory.</color>

items.name: 神经增强剂
items.desc: 一种先进的混合药物，能改变大脑的结构和功能，并永久性小幅提升机动性。你不会想使用第二次的。
items.descEn: An advanced mix of drugs that alters the structure and function of your brain, slightly increasing your mobility permanently. You might not want to use it more than once.

items.name: 无标识罐头
items.desc: 一罐无标识的、看起来没什么异样的...东西。从视外观和气味上无法分辨其成分。可能是好东西，也可能不是。
items.descEn: A bland, unlabeled can of... something. It doesn't look or smell like anything in particular. Might be good, might be not.

items.name: 空爆米花桶
items.desc: 纸质空桶，可存放物品。
items.descEn: Empty paper bucket. You could store something in it.

items.name: 营养棒
items.desc: 富含营养的压缩能量棒。味道平淡且永不腐败。
items.descEn: Solid, edible bar of pure nutrients and calories. Neutral taste, and doesn't spoil.

items.name: 鸦片注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的注射器，用于注射液体。标签写着过量剂量为200mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. The overdose label says 200ml.

items.name: 富氧晶碎片
items.desc: 它正咕噜冒泡，向周围释放氧气...贴身携带时可加速体力恢复。
items.descEn: It's bubbling away slowly, releasing oxygen into anything around it... Increases stamina regeneration while stored on your body.

items.name: 镇痛膏瓶
items.desc: 一个装有100mL镇痛膏的小瓶子。单次涂抹剂量为10mL。
items.descEn: A small 100ml bottle used to hold relief cream. Dosage is 10ml.

items.name: 止痛药瓶
items.desc: 一个容量为100mL的药瓶。单次口服剂量为10mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml pill bottle. Dosage is 10ml.

items.name: 煎饼
items.desc: 层层摊开煎制、处处淋满糖浆的香甜面饼。糖浆可能会沾到你的毛上，很美味！
items.descEn: A layered flat, sweet batter cooked on a hot surface, covered in syrup. Might get into your fur. Tasty!

items.name: 红椒炖鱼
items.desc: 由鱼肉糜、米饭、番茄酱和植物油制成的糊状食物，佐以洋葱、盐和香料。色香俱佳。
items.descEn: A paste made from ground fish, rice, tomato paste and vegetable oil, seasoned with onion, salt and spices. It looks and smells rather appealing.

items.name: 木制假肢
items.desc: 简易的木制假肢，用于替代失去的肢体。性能不如正常肢体且易损坏。可用木制材料修复。对胸/腹部使用以安装。需要7级智力才能可靠安装。
items.descEn: A makeshift wooden prosthesis to replace lost extremities. Less efficient than a normal limb and prone to breaking. Repair with wood. Use on the thorax/abdomen to attach. 7 INT is needed to attach reliably.

items.name: 干肉饼
items.desc: 由油脂、肉脯碎和果蔬干组成的混合物。保质期长，并且热量密度极高，就是味道一般。
items.descEn: A mixture of fat, dried meat, and dehydrated fruit. Lasts a long time and is very calorie-dense. Tastes neutral.

items.name: 操作增强型假肢
items.desc: 操作增强型假肢，在几乎所有方面都优于普通肢体。可用钛材料修复。对胸部/腹部使用以安装。需要14级智力才能可靠安装。
items.descEn: Prosthetic Enhanced Operation limb. Better than a normal limb in almost every way. Repaired with titanium. Use on the thorax/abdomen to attach. 14 INT is needed to attach reliably.

items.name: 十字镐
items.desc: 专业岩石挖掘工具，效率高但速度慢。
items.descEn: A tool specially crafted to dig rock. Very efficient at removing terrain, though slow.

items.name: 手枪
items.desc: 基础款半自动手枪，使用9毫米手枪弹匣。潮湿或低耐久时可能卡壳。主手持握以操作。
items.descEn: A basic, semi-automatic handgun. Uses small magazines loaded with 9mm rounds. Might jam when wet or low condition. Hold in your main hand to use and see controls.

items.name: 金属干草叉
items.desc: 钢制农具，用于翻动干草、秸秆等松散物料。
items.descEn: An agricultural tool used to pitch loose material, such as hay, straw, manure, or leaves. Made of steel.

items.name: 披萨片
items.desc: 烘烤过的披萨片。极其美味、饱腹且增重！
items.descEn: A slice of baked pizza. Very tasty, filling and fattening!

items.name: 等离子切割器
items.desc: 一种定向等离子流发生器。可高效切割金属块，亦能在医疗面板使用以灼烧止血。
items.descEn: A device that generates a directed flow of plasma. Very good at cutting through metal blocks. Can be used in the health panel to cauterize wounds.

items.name: 塑料袋
items.desc: 薄的蓝色塑料袋。
items.descEn: A thin, blue plastic bag.

items.name: 塑料绷带
items.desc: 一卷坚韧的特殊复合材料，能高效覆盖伤口并固定骨折。对肌肉健康无效。
items.descEn: A roll of specially synthesized tough material, made to efficiently cover wounds and stabilize fractures. Has no effect on muscle health.

items.name: 塑料块
items.desc: 一块柔韧的塑料，明显是从某处强行扯下来的。主要用于电子元件方面的制作。
items.descEn: A chunk of flexible plastic which has been visibly forcibly displaced. Usable in crafting, mainly in electronics.

items.name: 毛绒玩偶
items.desc: 捏它的时候会发出吱吱声。在情绪低落的时候，你可以把它当作发泄对象...
items.descEn: It makes a squeaky noise when you squish it. You could take your frustration out on it when feeling down...

items.name: 爆米花
items.desc: 一桶加热膨胀的玉米粒。对你而言，它新奇又美味。保质期极长。
items.descEn: A bucket containing a bunch of corn kernels, puffed up from being heated. You find it to be quite a novel concept. Tasty. Has a long shelf life.

items.name: 炮果
items.desc: 奇异又有光泽的方形果实。味道不错，能够缓解饥饿与口渴，但可能轻微缓解或加重辐射病。高速撞击地面时会发出巨响——方便估计坠落高度。
items.descEn: An odd, rectangular shiny fruit. Tasty, refills hunger and thirst. May randomly help or intensify radiation sickness slightly. Has a loud reaction when impacting the ground at speeds - useful for checking drop height.

items.name: 小袋
items.desc: 复合纤维编织成的绿色小包，没有提手。
items.descEn: A small green bag made of woven synthetic fiber. Has no handle.

items.name: 礼物
items.desc: 一个装饰精美的纸盒，里面似乎装着什么东西。使用后可以拆开它。
items.descEn: A decorated paper box, seemingly filled with something. Use it to unpack it.

items.name: 金属挖掘工具
items.desc: 装有沉重尖锐金属的棍棒，挖掘效率高于徒手。
items.descEn: A piece of sharp, heavy metal on a stick. Better at digging than claws.

items.name: 加工铜
items.desc: 一块经过生化处理的铜。可塑性和导电性优良，可以制成电子设备的线路。
items.descEn: Chunk of bio-chem processed copper. Malleable and conductive, you could turn it into wiring for electronics.

items.name: 手提包
items.desc: 用于携带个人物品的中型手提包。相当时尚！
items.descEn: A handheld medium-sized bag used to carry personal items. Quite stylish!

items.name: 旧布条
items.desc: 一块破旧、发皱的布条，可作为简易绷带使用。在物品栏使用可以擦干身体。
items.descEn: A worn, crumpled up rag. Can be used as decent makeshift dressing. Use in the inventory to dry yourself.

items.name: 耙子
items.desc: 用于松土等农事工作的工具。让你瞬间化身农夫！
items.descEn: Used for softening soil, along other things. Makes you feel like a farmer!

items.name: 测距仪
items.desc: 一款用于测量远处物体距离的设备。左键使用时会播报你指向目标的距离。
items.descEn: A device used to measure distances to remote objects. Tells you the distance to whatever you're pointing at when used.

items.name: 锈铜矿块
items.desc: 一块严重氧化的粗铜块。精炼后可以用于电子元件的制作。
items.descEn: Raw chunk of heavily oxidized copper. You could refine it for use in electronics.

items.name: 赤色纤维
items.desc: 你肯定有更重要的事情要去琢磨，话又说回来，它还是很好看的！
items.descEn: You have more important things to think about. That said, it does look quite pretty!

items.name: REL-超再生增幅芯片
items.desc: 一款先进的躯体芯片。以代谢速率提升为代价，高效促进创伤愈合。暂时派不上用场。
items.descEn: An advanced body chip that highly boosts the users injury regeneration abilities, in exchange for increased metabolism. You won't be able to make use of it until much later.

items.name: 0.0.7-紧急再生芯片
items.desc: 意识转移芯片的魔改模块，能利用预存的DNA和逝去宿主剩余的生化物质，狂放地重塑一副躯体。暂时派不上用场。
items.descEn: A crude enhancement to the mind-swap chip that allows the host to reform into a crude newly formed vessel using base DNA stored on the device and the biomass of whatever is left of the now dead host. You won't be able to make use of it until much later.

items.name: 镇痛晶碎片
items.desc: 握住它的时候会感到些许麻木...贴身携带时可减轻疼痛。
items.descEn: You feel a little numb holding it... Decreases pain while stored on your body.

items.name: 步枪
items.desc: 无托全自动步枪，使用5.56毫米步枪弹匣。潮湿或低耐久时可能卡壳。主手持握以操作。
items.descEn: A stockless, fully automatic rifle. Uses rifle magazines loaded with 5.56 rounds. Might jam when wet or low condition. Hold in your main hand to use and see controls.

items.name: 步枪弹匣
items.desc: 通用5.56毫米步枪弹匣。
items.descEn: A universal rifle magazine that accepts 5.56 rounds.

items.name: 小型静脉输液袋
items.desc: 一个带有注射针头的0.7L袋子，用于注射液体。
items.descEn: A 0.7L bag with a needle at the end, for injecting fluids intravenously.

items.name: 防暴头盔
items.desc: 一款先进的头盔，能大幅减轻所受的头部创伤。
items.descEn: An advanced helmet that greatly reduces the severity of head trauma.

items.name: 撕裂的绷带
items.desc: 一小堆撕碎的布料，可作为简易绷带用于止血。
items.descEn: A small pile of ripped clothing. Can be used as a makeshift bandage for bleeding wounds.

items.name: 纤维绳
items.desc: 几条植物纤维编织成的绳子，用于制作物品。
items.descEn: A few bits of foliage, tied together into a rope. Used for crafting.

items.name: 发光玫瑰
items.desc: 沙玫瑰上能绽放明亮黄色光芒的部分。光芒衰减很快，用来探测落差高度时很好用。在医疗面板中对肢体使用，还能揭示潜伏的感染。
items.descEn: A bright, far reaching yellow light that came from a sand rose. While it decays fast, it's useful for checking how big a drop is. Also reveals hidden infections if used on a limb.

items.name: 发光玫瑰荚
items.desc: 沙玫瑰的组成部分，不会腐坏。在物品栏使用以剥开。
items.descEn: A part of a sand rose. Doesn't spoil. Can be opened.

items.name: 垂麦球囊
items.desc: 填满了麦粒的薄囊。如果你有可用于捶打的工具，可以把它捣成粉。
items.descEn: A thin sack filled with grain. You could pound it down into a flour if you had a hammering tool.

items.name: 垂麦粉
items.desc: 常用于制作烘焙食品的粉末。你可能需要一些水和热源来加工它。
items.descEn: A powder mainly used in making baked goods. You'll probably need some water and a heat source to work with it.

items.name: 护目镜
items.desc: 坚固的塑料眼镜，提供基础头部防护。
items.descEn: A sturdy pair of plastic glasses. Offers minor head protection.

items.name: 静脉输液袋
items.desc: 一个带有注射针头的0.75L袋子，用于注射液体。
items.descEn: A 0.75L bag with a needle at the end, for injecting fluids intravenously.

items.name: 脚手架组件包
items.desc: 高度压缩的脚手架套装，便于快速搭建。可使用100次。
items.descEn: A hyper-compressed box of scaffolding, made to be easily placed down. Lasts 100 uses.

items.name: 围巾
items.desc: 红色、温暖、毛茸茸的长围巾，能够提供一定保温效果。让你宛如一位雇佣兵...
items.descEn: Red, warm, and fuzzy, this long scarf provides some insulation from the elements. Makes you feel like a mercenary...

items.name: 废料块
items.desc: 由废料金属熔合成的实心方块。强度不高，但用于制作已经足够。
items.descEn: Solid cube made of melted scrap metal. Not particularly strong, but will do in crafting.

items.name: 金属废料
items.desc: 从损毁机械上回收的零碎钢材。耐久度高于25%时可放置成物块。既是幸存者之间常用的交易通货，也可用于制作。
items.descEn: Bits and pieces of steel from destroyed machinery. Can be placed down if above 25% condition. Commonly used as currency between survivors, and for crafting.

items.name: 废料板
items.desc: 一块薄薄的废料金属。强度不高，但用于制作已经足够。
items.descEn: Thin sheet of scrap metal. Not particularly strong, but will do in crafting.

items.name: 废料管
items.desc: 由废料金属制成的空心金属管。强度不高，但用于制作已经足够。还可以当作简易锤子使用。
items.descEn: Hollow tube made of scrap metal. Not particularly strong, but will do in crafting. Could act as a shoddy makeshift hammer.

items.name: 高级潜水装备
items.desc: 允许你在水下无限呼吸并恢复体力，提高你在液体中的移动速度，并在浮出水面后快速干燥。附带改造版浮力装置。
items.descEn: Lets you indefinitely breathe and regenerate stamina underwater, makes you move faster in liquids and dries you out quickly after resurfacing. The pool floaties are retrofitted.

items.name: 泵动霰弹枪
items.desc: 无托内置弹仓霰弹枪，直接装填12号霰弹。潮湿或低耐久时可能卡壳。主手持握以操作。
items.descEn: A stockless, pump-action shotgun with an internal magazine. Uses 12 gauge shells loaded directly into the gun. Might jam when wet or low condition. Hold in your main hand to use and see controls.

items.name: 金属铲
items.desc: 专业设计的松散物料挖掘工具，不用教你都能知道怎么用。
items.descEn: A tool specially crafted to efficiently displace soil and other loose materials. While you haven't seen one of these before in your life, using it isn't exactly a science.

items.name: 金属镰刀
items.desc:
一件带有弧形刀刃的金属工具，用于收割作物或清理植被。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
A metal tool with a curved blade, made to harvest crops or cut through vegetation.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 大锤
items.desc: 一种长柄工具，头部是宽大扁平的金属。你听说他们总爱把这种东西扔进河里。
items.descEn: A tool with a large, flat metal head, attached to a long handle. You've heard they tend to be thrown into rivers.

items.name: 睡袋
items.desc: 睡眠用保温罩。在物品栏使用时，能提升睡眠质量一个等级（上限为优质），还能提供额外的保温效果。依然需要遵循常规睡眠限制。
items.descEn: An insulated covering for a person to sleep in. Use to sleep in it, bumping the sleeping quality up a tier (capped at Good) and giving you some insulation for the night. Normal sleep restrictions apply.

items.name: 安眠药盒
items.desc: 一板吸塑包装的安眠药，总量为25mL，单次口服剂量为5mL。包装上没有品牌名称。
items.descEn: A blister pack containing 25ml worth of pills. Dosage is 5ml. The brand name is missing.

items.name: 植物纤维挎包
items.desc: 加固过的植物纤维挎包，能斜挎在背上。
items.descEn: A foliage bag with added reinforcements, made to be worn on your back.

items.name: 小型电池
items.desc: 小型通用电池，容量为中型电池的一半。
items.descEn: A small battery that can be inserted into various electronic devices. Stores half as much as a medium battery.

items.name: 手枪弹匣
items.desc: 通用9毫米手枪弹匣。
items.descEn: A universal handgun magazine that accepts 9mm rounds.

items.name: 小型背包
items.desc: 皮质小背包。
items.descEn: A small leather backpack.

items.name: 运动鞋
items.desc: 非犬足设计的白色运动鞋。勉强穿上后可防玻璃碎片。
items.descEn: A pair of white sneakers, that are not at all made to go over your feet. If you manage to somehow squish your paws in them, provides protection from glass shards.

items.name: 汽水瓶
items.desc: 一个1L的塑料瓶。
items.descEn: A liter plastic bottle.

items.name: 汽水罐
items.desc: 一个0.25L的汽水罐。
items.descEn: A 0.25L soda can.

items.name: 硝普钠瓶
items.desc: 一个装有100mL硝普钠的小瓶子。药物仅在注射使用时有效，所以你需要另备一支注射器取用。
items.descEn: A 100ml bottle with sodium nitroprusside. As the medication only works intravenously, you will need to get a separate syringe to fill and use.

items.name: 宁神晶碎片
items.desc: 散发令人安宁的气息。贴身携带时可缓慢提升情绪值。
items.descEn: It has a calming aura to it. Slowly increases happiness while stored on your body.

items.name: 汤碗
items.desc: 一个0.3L的深口小碗。
items.descEn: A small closed bowl that can hold 0.3L of liquid.

items.name: 空间排水器
items.desc: 运用先进传送技术排干你身旁液体的装置。没人知道液体被传送到哪去了...不过这也不是你需要操心的问题。会自动充能。
items.descEn: Using advanced teleportation technology, it can drain liquids away from you on use. No one really knows where the lost matter goes... Not like that's your problem, though. Automatically recharges.

items.name: 辛香叶
items.desc: 一根长满鲜亮叶片的干燥茎秆。可以食用，但味道辛辣。可用于消毒，也可以在制作时作为纤维使用。
items.descEn: A dry stalk with numerous bright leaves. Can be eaten, though it is spicy. Can be used on limbs as antiseptic. Usable as foliage for crafting.

items.name: 夹板
items.desc: 用于固定骨折和脱臼的坚固木板，可辅助肢体恢复。夹板穿戴在健康的肢体上会限制其活动，进而降低你的运动能力。
items.descEn: A sturdy board, made to aid fractures. Helps with healing fractures and dislocations. Putting it on a functional limb will still immobilize it, reducing your capabilities.

items.name: 喷雾瓶
items.desc: 一个带喷嘴的0.2L瓶子。每次喷出10mL液体。能帮你正确使用消毒剂。
items.descEn: A 0.2L bottle with a spray nozzle on it. Sprays 10ml of liquid at a time. Good for correct use of antiseptics.

items.name: 肉排
items.desc: 精心烹制的大块肉排。饱腹、增重且美味！
items.descEn: A big, nicely cooked and prepared piece of meat. Filling, fattening and tasty!

items.name: 钢制假肢
items.desc: 用于替换缺失四肢的金属假肢。在大多数方面与正常肢体无异。可用金属材料修复。对胸部/腹部使用以安装。需要10级智力才能可靠安装。
items.descEn: A metal prosthesis to replace lost extremities. Equal to a normal limb in most ways. Repair with scrap. Use on the thorax/abdomen to attach. 10 INT is needed to attach reliably.

items.name: 消毒绷带
items.desc: 一卷带有敷料的绷带，用于减缓出血、固定骨折并促进皮肤愈合。可抵抗感染。对肌肉健康无效。
items.descEn: A roll of dressing with a bandage, used to slow down bleeding, stabilize fractures and aid skin healing. Counteracts infections. Has no effect on muscle health.

items.name: 木棍
items.desc: 一根短木棒，质脆易碎，却也轻盈方便。它短到根本无法当作武器使用，顶多当作简易锤子。
items.descEn: A short wooden stick. While it's very frail, it's also light. Way too small to use as a weapon. Could act as a shoddy makeshift hammer.

items.name: 闭合石果
items.desc: 一颗坚硬的绿色果实，卡在植株灰色的硬壳里，需用牙齿咬开分离。
items.descEn: A hard green fruit stuck to a hard, gray part of its plant. You need to separate it using your teeth first.

items.name: 石果
items.desc: 味道平淡的硬质绿色果实，含中等脂肪。食用后会明显口渴。
items.descEn: A hard green fruit with a neutral taste and medium fat content. It's very dry, you'll probably be thirsty after it.

items.name: 链激酶注射器
items.desc: 一支100mL的自动注射器。单次注射剂量为34mL。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe with an auto-injector at the end. Dosage is ~34mL.

items.name: 雪行者毛皮
items.desc: 从雪行者身上剥取的大片白色厚实毛皮，提供卓越的保暖性能。
items.descEn: A large piece of thick, fluffy white pelt ripped from a snow strider. Offers considerable insulation from the elements.

items.name: 细绳
items.desc: 由植物纤维制成的细绳，看似脆弱实则耐用。用于更复杂的配方。
items.descEn: A thin, deceptively durable string made of prepared plant matter. Used in more intricate recipes.

items.name: 0.2.9-意识转移芯片
items.desc: 一款神秘的躯体芯片。它能够与宿主建立连接，使宿主在死亡后将意识转移至芯片中，最终再转移到新的躯体内。暂时派不上用场。
items.descEn: A mysterious body chip that links with its host, allowing them to quickly move their consciousness onto the chip and then onto a new vessel shortly post-mortem. You won't be able to make use of it until much later.

items.name: 注射器
items.desc: 一支可用于注射液体的100mL注射器。它是手工制作的。
items.descEn: A 100ml syringe which can inject fluid intravenously. It's handmade.

items.name: 战术靴
items.desc: 一双复合材料制成的重型靴子，能有效保护双脚免受各种形式的创伤。
items.descEn: A pair of heavy synthetic boots, made to effectively protect the feet from various forms of trauma.

items.name: 战术手套
items.desc: 一副先进复合材料制成的手套。能有效保护双手免受各种形式的物理创伤。
items.descEn: A pair of advanced synthetic gloves. Effectively protects your hands from physical trauma.

items.name: 地形扫描仪
items.desc: 能显示下方24米半径范围内的低精度地图。其中绿色代表普通物块，红色代表各类建筑。测绘可能有误差。
items.descEn: Shows you a low-quality map of the terrain below you. Terrain is highlighted in green, solid buildings in red. Might be slightly inaccurate. Goes 24 meters down.

items.name: 钛合金砍刀
items.desc:
一把性能卓越且经久耐用的武器，挥动时既轻巧又顺手，同时又锋利致命。刀口经过高温处理，可长期保持锋利。它是出色的自卫武器，万不得已时也可作为挖掘工具使用。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
A very capable and durable tool for combat, both easy and light to swing, yet razor-sharp and devastating. Its edge is heat treated to keep its sharpness for a long time. An amazing tool for self defense, and can be used as a digging tool as a last resort.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 钛合金多功能工具
items.desc:
一件小巧却极为坚固耐用的制作工具。顶端配有沉重锤头，握柄内藏有微小却锋利的刃片。并不适合用于挖掘或战斗，但在制作中经久耐用，几乎不会磨损，还很轻便。

<color="red">可在医疗面板中截除肢体。
items.descEn:
A small, yet very firm and durable tool used for crafting, with a heavy hammer top and a tiny yet razor sharp blade hidden in the handle. While not useful for digging nor combat, it will last nigh indefinitely for all sorts of crafting recipes, and is light.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate limbs.

items.name: 钛镐
items.desc: 一件由钛金属锻造制成的精致工具。极其耐用，挖掘效率也很优秀，但不太适合作为武器。
items.descEn: A finely crafted tool, made out of forged titanium. Very durable and efficient at removing terrain, though not very combat capable.

items.name: 钛棒
items.desc: 一根由高强度钛合金制成的实心棒。可用于高级制作，也可充当简易锤子。
items.descEn: A solid rod made of a strong titanium alloy. Can be used for advanced crafting, and as a makeshift hammer.

items.name: 钛板
items.desc: 一种由高强度钛合金制成的板材，轻盈坚固。可用于高级制造。
items.descEn: A thin, yet firm sheet made of a strong titanium alloy. Can be used for advanced crafting.

items.name: 厚钛板
items.desc: 一块由高强度钛合金制成的矩形厚板。可用于高级制作。
items.descEn: A rectangular slab made of a strong titanium alloy. Can be used for advanced crafting.

items.name: 工具箱
items.desc: 常用于存放工具的重型金属箱。
items.descEn: A big, heavy steel box, made to hold tools.

items.name: 火把
items.desc: 非常原始的光源。虽然它能很好地照亮通路，但会被液体熄灭。你可以用火源来重新点燃它。
items.descEn: Extremely primitive lightsource. While it lights up the way pretty well, it will be put out by liquids. You can relight it with a flame source.

items.name: 破衬衫
items.desc: 一件破旧的蓝色衬衫，提供轻微防护和保暖。
items.descEn: An old, torn blue shirt. Provides a small bit of protection and insulation.

items.name: 止血带
items.desc: 使用时会阻断肢体血液循环，止住远心端全部出血（但不减少出血）。需定时解除以免造成肢体缺氧和疼痛。可重复使用。
items.descEn: When applied, it cuts off circulation to the limb, stopping all bleeding in the affected area (though it does not heal the wound). It must be removed after some time, as it causes pain and deprives the limb of oxygen. Reusable.

items.name: 垃圾袋
items.desc: 黑色塑料袋。
items.descEn: A black plastic bag.

items.name: 战术胸挂
items.desc: 一件先进复合材料制成的胸挂，可携带各类工具、武器和医疗装备，同时还能保护你的躯干。
items.descEn: An advanced synthetic protective pouch that can hold various tools, weapons and medical gear. Also protects your torso!

items.name: 园艺铲
items.desc: 一件木柄金属头的基础园艺工具，挖掘效率大概比徒手强一些。
items.descEn: Primitive gardening tool, made of wood and metal. Probably better than using your claws.

items.name: 激荡晶碎片
items.desc: 其中蕴含能量，持续嗡嗡震动。贴身携带时可增加跳跃高度。
items.descEn: It vibrates with energy. Increases jump height while stored on your body.

items.name: 镊子
items.desc: 一把普通的金属镊子，可干净利落地从肢体无痛拔出破片。
items.descEn: A simple pair of metal tweezers. Can cleanly and painlessly remove shrapnel from limbs.

items.name: 血管加压素瓶
items.desc: 一个装有100mL血管加压素的小瓶子。药物仅在注射使用时有效，所以你需要另备一支注射器取用。
items.descEn: A 100ml bottle with vasopressin. As the medication only works intravenously, you will need to get a separate syringe to fill and use.

items.name: 毒腺
items.desc: 一颗能产生并储存血毒素的小型唾液腺。你或许能将其加工为抗毒血清。
items.descEn: A tiny salivary gland that produces and stores hemotoxin. You could probably process it into some kind of antivenom.

items.name: 电子表
items.desc: 它会定期播报实用信息（失血计时、潜伏感染、体重变化等）。使用以查看本次探索用时和环境温度。有个口袋伙伴真安心！
items.descEn: Periodically tells you useful info (bleeding time, hidden infections, weight changes, etc). When used, displays run time and temperature. Having a pocket buddy is comforting!

items.name: 水瓶
items.desc: 一个0.5L的塑料瓶。里面有干净的水。
items.descEn: A 0.5L plastic bottle. Comes with clean water.

items.name: 水罐
items.desc: 一个3L的大号塑料罐。
items.descEn: A large, 3L jug.

items.name: 木块
items.desc: 由木材融合成的实心方块。质脆易碎，却也轻盈方便。
items.descEn: Solid cube made of melted together wood. While it's very frail, it's also light.

items.name: 木质挖掘工具
items.desc: 一把带柄的削尖木块，效率仅略优于徒手挖掘。
items.descEn: A piece of sharpened wood on a stick. Barely better at digging than claws.

items.name: 木板
items.desc: 由木材制成的薄板。质脆易碎，却也轻盈方便。
items.descEn: Thin sheet made of wood. While it's very frail, it's also light.

items.name: 木镐
items.desc: 一把用劣质材料制成的镐。挖掘效率尚可，但容易损坏且挥动缓慢。
items.descEn: A pickaxe made out of a particularly disappointing material. Efficient at removing terrain, but slow and brittle.

items.name: 木制干草叉
items.desc: 木质农具，用于翻动干草、秸秆等松散物料。
items.descEn: An agricultural tool used to pitch loose material, such as hay, straw, manure, or leaves. Made of wood.

items.name: 木屐
items.desc: 一块用绳子绑在你爪子上的木板。这一点都不舒服，但它能保护你免受尖锐碎片的伤害...如果你够幸运的话，还能保护不止一次！
items.descEn: A wood panel attached to your paws with rope. Not comfortable in any way, but it will protect you from sharp debris... If you're lucky, more than one time!

items.name: 木屑
items.desc: 粉碎的木材。或许能制成某种材料。
items.descEn: Bits and pieces of smashed wood. You could probably make them into a crafting material.

items.name: 木铲
items.desc: 轻质脆性材料制成的松散物料挖掘工具。
items.descEn: A tool specially crafted to efficiently displace soil and other loose materials. Made with a brittle, yet light material.

items.name: 木镰刀
items.desc: 一件带有弧形刀刃的木质工具，用于收割作物或清理植被。
items.descEn: A wooden tool with a curved blade, made to harvest crops or cut through vegetation.

items.name: 木制园艺铲
items.desc: 一件全木制的基础园艺工具，也许比徒手好使...？
items.descEn: Primitive gardening tool, made of wood. Probably better than using your claws...?

items.name: 伤口粘合胶瓶
items.desc: 一支80mL的管状容器，通常装有伤口粘合胶。每次使用可挤出20mL内容物。
items.descEn: A 80ml tube, usually filled with wound glue. Applies 20ml of liquid per use.

items.name: 扳手
items.desc: 一种能提供握点、借由杠杆原理对物体施加扭矩、使其旋转的工具。相比徒手能更有效矫正关节脱位。此外，它还可用作不错的捶打工具。
items.descEn: A tool used to provide grip and mechanical advantage in applying torque to turn objects. Can be used on dislocated limbs to correct them more effectively than with your bare hands. Also makes for a decent hammering tool.
